question.en: Consider the following statements regarding cropping systems in India:
question.hi: Consider the following statements regarding cropping systems in India:

text.en: In relay cropping, the succeeding crop is planted before the harvesting of the standing crop.
text.hi: In relay cropping, the succeeding crop is planted before the harvesting of the standing crop.

text.en: Mixed cropping involves growing crops in definite row patterns to maximize resource sharing.
text.hi: Mixed cropping involves growing crops in definite row patterns to maximize resource sharing.

explanation.en: Statement 1 is correct as relay cropping involves overlapping crop cycles to reduce turnaround time. Statement 2 is incorrect because mixed cropping involves sowing seeds without any distinct row arrangement, whereas intercropping uses row patterns.

question.en: Match the cropping terminology in List I with their descriptions in List II:
question.hi: Match the cropping terminology in List I with their descriptions in List II:

right.en: A. Growing the same crop continuously on the same land
right.hi: A. Growing the same crop continuously on the same land

right.en: B. Utilizing crop stubble for a subsequent harvest
right.hi: B. Utilizing crop stubble for a subsequent harvest

right.en: C. Growing two or more crops simultaneously in definite rows
right.hi: C. Growing two or more crops simultaneously in definite rows

right.en: D. Sowing seeds of multiple crops mixed together without rows
right.hi: D. Sowing seeds of multiple crops mixed together without rows

explanation.en: Monoculture is continuous cultivation of one crop (1-A). Ratooning uses stubble regrowth (2-B). Intercropping uses definite rows (3-C). Mixed cropping lacks row arrangement (4-D).

question.en: Discuss the significance of cropping intensity and diversified cropping systems in enhancing agricultural resilience and farmers' income in India.
question.hi: Discuss the significance of cropping intensity and diversified cropping systems in enhancing agricultural resilience and farmers' income in India.

modelAnswer.en: Introduction: Define cropping intensity and state its importance as an indicator of land use efficiency.
